ui: v2rayNG-style per-app enable/bypass switches, app icon/name/package checkboxes, search, select/invert and system-app filter; source attribution included. 0.90.7-0.90.10 keeps the 0.90.8 layout: navigation 6.4vp lower with the system gesture inset, running bar at 84% of the original size and 84% dashboard width, content extending behind floating controls, and Clash group cards keyed by group structure rather than selection/latency.
material: 0.90.9 thin smoke glass: when native immersive ULTRA_THIN material is available, no 40% base tint and no extra 12vp background blur are added; native tint is 3% dark / 6% light, with a 6vp light-blur fallback on lower-capability devices. The navigation selection uses a pale translucent highlight with a neutral light effect; the full-width header covers the status bar without an extra border or shadow. The reduce-transparency setting still uses solid surfaces.
background: 0.90.6 gates Tailscale UI status snapshots on a live UI activity lease: while the UI is backgrounded, publishTailscaleStatus returns before calling nativeCore.tailscaleStatus and before writing tailscale-status.json; snapshots resume in the foreground. The Tailscale connection, explicit commands, VPN heartbeat, core health checks, network-change handling, SSID suspend/direct policy and manual-stop priority are unchanged. The extension still supervises the owned OS VPN channel separately from native core state; confirmed absence triggers TUN/core rebuild, unknown inventory and node latency failures never prove VPN loss, and bounded backoff/cooldown remain. No claim of resurrecting a fully killed process in background.
validation_limit: 0.90.10 targeted 26 display-state, real selection, auto-test batch, node-retention and VPN-recovery tests passed; the full tool suite retains historical failures. The unsigned 0.90.10 stable and Beta HAPs have not been installed on a device in this round. Actual frame rate, tap latency, native material rendering, long-run background behavior, power and memory have not been compared on-device. Prior IPv6 and WebRTC limitations remain.
startup_change: Encrypted candidate files use complete fd writes, fsync, close and authenticated read-back before promotion. First-tap phone regression remains unverified.
application_catalog: Real bundle.getAllApplicationInfo behind GET_BUNDLE_INFO_PRIVILEGED check. Normal signing remains blocked; requires-acl HAP declares permission but still needs an approved signing profile. No successful on-phone enumeration claim.
network_change: Preserve last validated underlay through transient none. Use bearer capability in signature. Cross-bearer IPv6 TUN rebuilds use a separate bounded budget, reset after success. Network events cancel live URLTest before serialized reset/rebuild. Failed policy file watcher falls back to checks on existing1s foreground/3s background heartbeat.
persistence: Successful manual selector/mode commands are saved by the VPN Extension to a per-profile encrypted persistent choice catalog outside disposable runtime storage. Initial and resumed launches apply saved defaults before core validation/start. UI card visibility/group expansion/log filter/system app visibility use stable preferences. No raw profile JSON rewrite. Same signing identity and preserved application data required for in-place upgrades.
privacy: Independent disable-STUN switch maps to persisted strictWebRtc; rules/global reject recognized UDP STUN before custom routing regardless of proxy-STUN toggle. Original profiles and storage namespace preserved. IPv6 leakage not claimed fixed.
dashboard_modes: Deduplicate case aliases and display Direct, Rule, Global in that order. Privacy adaptation retains configured mode values without introducing upper/lowercase aliases.
quick_start: One non-deletable base profile merges mainland direct (cn + geoip-cn), GFW proxy and a default proxy route. Groups are proxy (selector: auto + all nodes, default auto) and auto (URLTest over all nodes). The profile carries its own TUN inbound with IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and omits the TUN stack option deprecated in 1.15. IPv6 is no longer a switch: it is enabled only when the selected profile contains IPv6 (TUN address, DNS or node address), otherwise IPv6 is rejected in-tunnel and DNS is ipv4_only. The dashboard picker supports swipe edit/delete, long-press multi-select and select-all, and shows a red hint when the base profile is selected without imported nodes. Legacy split presets migrate into the base profile.
manual_add: Manual add follows the v2rayNG flow: a protocol menu (VMess, VLESS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, Hysteria2) opens a protocol-specific form using remarks/address/port/id/security/network/TLS field names, with method+alterId for VMess, method for Shadowsocks, flow for VLESS, and path/host only for ws/grpc/http. The raw share-link editor stays available for protocol extensions.
builtin_lock: The base profile shows a grey builtin chip instead of a delete action in profiles and the dashboard picker; single and batch deletion reject builtin ids and deleteSfaProfile throws for them.
rule_sets: Base config updates cn.srs, geoip-cn.srs and gfw.srs from sing-geosite/sing-geoip. All files are staged as candidates, checked for the SRS magic, then renamed together; failures keep the old rule-sets. Startup only seeds missing files, so runtime-updated rule-sets survive restarts.
runtime_nodes: Nodes can be added, edited or removed while the base profile runs. Each change rebuilds the base profile, re-adapts and re-validates the config, then restarts the core and VPN; zero nodes stops the proxy. A failed restart keeps the saved nodes and reports an error instead of silently keeping the old config.
resilience: Every config apply records the currently running config first; if the new config fails to start the client reconnects with the previous one and keeps the VPN up. A failed rule-set update keeps the old files and the running session. After a successful base-profile start the rule-sets refresh silently at most once per 24h and are applied with a silent restart; failures stay silent and keep the old rules.
base_config: Base profile mirrors the reference profile: log, dns-remote (https via proxy) + dns-local with final dns-remote, dual-stack TUN inbound, selector proxy(AUTO, nodes, direct) default AUTO, urltest AUTO, route.final proxy (mainland-excluded) or direct (GFW), auto_detect_interface true, default_domain_resolver dns-local. Reference nodes are not embedded; only imported nodes are used.
node_import: Node page header has a + menu: manual input, QR import and URL import. QR and URL detect node links, https subscriptions and sing-box JSON; JSON proxy outbounds are converted to nodes while selectors, urltest, direct and block are skipped.
regression_fix: Restored forced route.auto_detect_interface=false and the injected TUN stack=gvisor: the native layer already protects and binds outbound sockets, so sing-box's own interface detection picked the wrong interface and broke node latency tests and custom profiles. Removed the forced URLTest after a network change because it holds the core mutex; AUTO keeps a 1 minute interval instead.
node_latency_ui: Node import list has a Clash-style lightning test button that measures every imported node sequentially with an in-button progress counter and per-row ms/timeout badges. The outbound tag now matches the base profile exactly (name · id). Tests only run while the base profile is the running config, otherwise the button explains why.
ipv6_leak: Original user screenshot shows carrier IPv6 while proxy IPv4 is present. Dual-stack route declaration is insufficient proof of capture. Subsequent Wi-Fi test had no working IPv6 HTTPS, so original IPv6 issue remains unresolved.
ipv6_policy: Runtime config declares dual-stack TUN and requests OS routes for both families; no forced IPv6 DNS suppression. Capture on a usable IPv6 network remains to be validated.
ui_material: 0.90.9 uses native immersive ULTRA_THIN without the previous 40% tint and extra 12vp blur; native tint drops to 3%/6%, fallback blur to 6vp, header border/shadow is removed, and the navigation selection becomes a pale translucent highlight. Reduce-transparency still uses solid surfaces. The layout from 0.90.8 (no extra bottom reservation, running bar 120% of 0.90.7 and 84% dashboard width) is retained.
proxy_group: The base profile proxy selector contains AUTO plus imported nodes only; direct remains a separate outbound used by direct rules and is no longer offered as a proxy member.
upgrade_restart: The UI stores the last seen versionName and a persistent vpn-active intent. On an in-place upgrade, if the VPN was running (or the status already reports an interrupted heartbeat), it safely stops the stale session and reconnects with the selected profile about 1.5s after startup. Fresh installs and previously stopped sessions are not auto-started.
ssid_ui: On-demand SSID page uses the node-list pattern: glass cards, right-swipe edit, left-swipe delete, long-press multi-select with select-all, header + button, empty-state card, and rename via the same editor.
node_probe: Independent node probing and prior 0.80 device observations retained; 0.90.10 signed-package retest pending.
webrtc_dns_block: Base profile rejects STUN hostnames at the DNS layer (domain_regex ^stun\., action reject) in both routing modes, following dae's approach; literal or cached STUN addresses still fall under the TUN capture and the STUN sniff/route rules.
storage_compatibility: Fixed accidental Beta package-wide replacement of HUKS alias and AES-GCM AAD. Canonical namespace independent of bundle; authenticated read compatibility for exact0.2.38/39 Beta pair; no generation on decrypt, key deletion or plaintext fallback. Existing envelope schema/algorithm/parameters retained. prepare-beta.ps1 modifies explicit identity fields only and checks cipher/store byte parity.
channel_policy: The bundled upstream core version and upstream prerelease flag determine channel; application version does not imply core stability.
ui_navigation: Bottom navigation is 6.4vp lower while keeping the system gesture safe area; the running bar is 84% of the original size (120% of 0.90.7) and 84% dashboard width, with proportional text, icons, spacing and radius. Dashboard and page content extend behind the floating navigation and running bar, and the full-width header glass covers the status bar plus the 64vp toolbar.
app_update: Daily foreground GitHub release check plus manual settings check, stable/prerelease channels isolated by core version; opens release page for user signing and in-place upgrade; no silent installation.
validation: 26 related Node tests pass (display-state reuse, real selection handling, auto URLTest batch, node retention and VPN recovery). Both HAP builds, app identity, versionCode 1000119, native-library Deflate compression and ZIP integrity were checked. Existing full-suite baseline failures remain; no new signed-device test was performed for this release.
background_health_fix: 0.90.6 suppresses Tailscale UI snapshots while the UI activity lease is inactive; foreground polling resumes the snapshot. Transient sample failures remain supervised and a later success clears diagnostics. No proof yet of preventing OS process termination or fixing every VPN drop.
source_variant: Stable; matching complete source ZIP from the public release commit and v0.90.10 tag
native_transport: Per-client in-process bufconn gRPC only; CommandServer.Start is not called during native initialization; no command.sock or listening port created.
native_device_validation: The packaged native core hash is unchanged from 0.90.5 for each channel; no signed-device install of 0.90.10 was performed in this round.
auth_ui: Based on Android SFA TailscaleEndpointScreen: open web authentication link, show QR dialog, copy link; Chinese state captions. Auth URLs never added to diagnostic messages.
changes_since_0_90_5: 0.90.6 background Tailscale UI snapshot gate; 0.90.7-0.90.8 navigation, running-bar, header and bottom-spacing layout; 0.90.9 thin smoke glass, neutral selection highlight, status-bar-covering header and no extra header rim/shadow; 0.90.10 Clash group card reuse, immediate 切换中 state, duplicate-submit suppression and aborting the remaining auto URLTest batch; v2rayH lifecycle/source comparison with no network-stack or kernel change.
node_selection: Clash group card identity is derived from group tag/type/selectable and node structure, excluding the selected node and URLTest delays, so selection or latency refreshes keep the card and expanded grid alive. Selections and delays update through independent maps and identical snapshots do not churn UI state. A tap shows 切换中 immediately, duplicate taps or an in-flight switch are suppressed, a failure keeps the last acknowledged selection, and manual selection stops submitting the remaining auto URLTest batch without force-cancelling tests already started by the core or restarting the VPN/core.
